thread:
maya-cs: Heads-up — AtlasLayer renewal is hitting legal/finance today. They've requested the invoice be issued to their EU entity (AtlasLayer EU) but payment will come via a US PO/credit card. There's a tax ID mismatch and they want wire instructions if we can accept wire instead of CC. Customer says wire needs to clear by 2024-03-28 or they postpone. Can ops/legal weigh in?

aj-am: Thanks Maya. Quick Q — are we still on the 12mo term or did they request 9mo? pricing needs lock before changing invoice.

maya-cs: They're okay to keep 12mo, but asked for a 10% credit if we switch to net45. They prefer net30 but want flexibility. PO number they provided: PO-AL-7721.

sofia-legal: @maya-cs ping — for multi-entity billing + PO we need signed authority and a payment acceptance check. Can you share the signer name and whether the PO explicitly authorizes billing to AtlasLayer EU? Also paste the Docusign envelope id if created. If there's a delegated signer clause needed, we may require wet signature depending on country rules.

maya-cs: Signer is "Evan K." — title: Head of Procurement. PO text says: "AtlasLayer will pay via corporate PO; invoicing to AtlasLayer EU." I created a DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC12345 (sent).

bryan-ops: We can issue invoice to AtlasLayer EU but only if payment method is wire or ACH to the EU entity bank. If they insist on charging a US CC for an EU entity invoice, our finance needs a vendor code + tax form. Do they have a vendor code? Also we can generate a proforma invoice to attach to the PO while legal clears the signature.

maya-cs: Vendor code from customer: VL-9972. Billing contact: finance-eu@atlaslayer.example. I've attached the PO snippet: ``PO-AL-7721
Bill To: AtlasLayer EU
Vendor Code: VL-9972
Payment: Wire preferred, Net30``

aj-am: If finance will accept wire, can we confirm wire details and whether there's any FX / VAT handling required? Also confirm whether credit card fallback is allowed if wire misses the date. Customer said they can do CC as backup but prefer wire.

sofia-legal: From legal side: we can proceed with DocuSign signature for the amendment. If tax ID mismatch remains we need a short addendum confirming the billing entity and indemnity for tax exposure. Example clause we can add: ```Billing Entity Confirmation: Customer confirms AtlasLayer EU is responsible for VAT and related taxes on invoices issued to AtlasLayer EU. Customer will indemnify Redwood Inference for any tax liabilities arising from incorrect billing entity information.```

bryan-ops: Sounds good. I'll prepare an invoice draft to AtlasLayer EU with the vendor code and include our wire instructions. I'll also add a note for FX: invoice in EUR, send wire to EUR account; if they wire USD we may need remittance instructions.

maya-cs: Sending invoice contact to customer now. I asked them to sign the DocuSign envelope and to confirm whether they'll use wire or CC if the wire is delayed.

docu-bot: DocuSign envelope ABC12345 — status: sent (1 pending signers). View: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC12345

sofia-legal: @bryan-ops please hold final invoice until I get approved addendum text from the customer or until they sign the DocuSign. If they sign but don't provide VAT confirmation, we'll add the indemnity clause.

bryan-ops: Will do. ETA to draft invoice + remittance: 45m.

maya-cs: Customer replied — they will try wire first, fallback to CC if wire not cleared by 3/28. They've started internal legal review of the addendum. Keeping fingers crossed. :crossed_fingers:

aj-am: OK — I'll note the credit request (10% for net45) in the renewal doc and get final approval if they push for it.

maya-cs: Thx everyone — I'll post when envelope is signed or if finance needs anything else. :thumbsup:
